newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-ALEXELA MULLS SHARE ISSUE, SEEKS LISTING.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-ALEXELA MULLS SHARE ISSUE, SEEKS LISTING.

text.p: Estonia's oil company Alexela plans to raise its share capital by about 30 million kroons from its present 26 million kroons via a share issue this year, it said on Thursday.
"The issue would start in October or November," the company's managing director Heiti Haal told Reuters, adding that it would seek the bourse listing after the issue's distribution.
Haal added it was too early to make comments on the share price or other conditions.

Alexela, a petrol station chain, which has a market share of 15-17 percent in Estonia, needs capital for its development, Haal said. He added it was in preliminary talks to acquire some small market performers.
